sections.section: Diffusion Models Already Have a Semantic Latent Space (p. 1–35)

omissions.source: Preechakul et al. (2022) introduces an additional input to the reverse diffusion process: a latent vector from an original image embedded by an extra encoder... However, it requires training from scratch and does not match with pretrained diffusion models.
Spoiler alert: our semantic latent space is different from the intermediate latent variables in the diffusion process.
The code is available at https://github.com/kwonminki/Asyrp official
h-space in the latent diffusion models such as stable diffusion, is another interesting research direction.

distortions.source: (b) Adding random noise with magnitude of ∆ϵ smiling t and random direction in ϵ -space leads to severely distorted images. (c) Adding random noises with tripled magnitude produce diverse visual changes in realistic images.
distortions.summary: The image contains three color photographs arranged side by side, each showing a headshot of a woman with long dark hair. In the left photo she has a neutral expression... in the right photo she has a neutral expression with closed lips and the facial features appear less sharp

additions.summary: argues that frozen, pretrained diffusion models already contain a semantic latent space, contrary to the common belief that they lack one
